proposals.summary: Record the measured Dynamic MoE direct-lowering regression, its expert-GMM partial win, and the strict implementation-vs-paper decision boundary.
Add architecture/inference-time/bottleneck applicability checks before selecting a Paper-to-Ascend method.
Expose Dense MTP on NPU0-3/8220 and Prefix Cache on NPU4-7/8210 as concurrent branch-local work, and mark Dynamic MoE audit-only/superseded for the current dense target.
